item.description: A legal dispute has emerged between Geisinger and St. Luke’s University Health Network following a recent announcement that St. Luke’s will assume full ownership of Geisinger St. Luke’s Hospital in Orwigsburg. In a statement released this week, Geisinger Clinic confirmed it is pursuing legal action against St. Luke’s University Health Network, alleging improper actions related to the pending end of their joint venture at the Orwigsburg hospital. item.title: North Schuylkill Board Approves Dave Reeder as New Head Girls’ Soccer Coach
item.description: The North Schuylkill School District Board of Education approved the hiring of Dave Reeder of Ashland as the Spartans’ new Head Girls’ Soccer Coach at Wednesday night’s meeting. Reeder takes over the program following the resignation of Clint Warner, who stepped down at the conclusion of the 2025 season after four years leading the Lady Spartans. item.title: North Schuylkill Claims Team Title at 2026 Schuylkill League Wrestling Tournament
item.description: North Schuylkill Claims Team Title at 2026 Schuylkill League Wrestling Tournament POTTSVILLE, Pa. — North Schuylkill captured the team championship at the 2026 Schuylkill League Wrestling Tournament, held January 17 at historic Martz Hall in Pottsville. item.title: Panther Valley Grinds Out 33-30 Schuylkill League Win Over Tamaqua
item.description: Panther Valley picked up a hard-fought Schuylkill League Division 2 road victory Wednesday night, edging Tamaqua 33-30 in a back-and-forth dual meet at Tamaqua Area High School. The match came down to key bonus points and forfeits, as Panther Valley used three forfeits and a pair of pins to secure the narrow win. item.title: WEATHER ALERT: Cold Weather Advisory Issued for Schuylkill County
item.description: The National Weather Service has issued a Cold Weather Advisory for Schuylkill County.COLD WEATHER ADVISORY IN EFFECT FROM 10 PM FRIDAY TO 10 AM EST SATURDAY... * WHAT...Very cold wind chills as low as 10 below expected. * WHERE...Adams, Cumberland, Dauphin, Franklin, Lancaster, Lebanon, Perry, Schuylkill, and York Counties. * WHEN...From 10 PM Friday to 10 AM EST Saturday. * IMPACTS...The cold wind chills as low as 10 below zero could result in hypothermia if precautions are not taken.---------
